shouldFix.title: The replacement G22 vector roster drops still-required v42 attestation and parser tests
evidence: v42's current required roster named valid Ed25519, wrong key, wrong member digest, altered kexec-absent token, malformed 64-byte signature, duplicate builderRoot, absent builderRoot, multiple linux_banner, official and loaded-section payload positives, absent IKCONFIG with valid builderAttestation, payloadDigest mismatch versus P, absent key, non-32-byte key, and digest/root mismatch, in addition to its marker and header tests.

v43 replaces that single JSON string rather than appending to it. The new REQUIRED-each-named string no longer names wrong member digest, altered kexecCapability, duplicate builderRoot, absent builderRoot, multiple linux_banner, loaded-section payload acceptance, absent branch with a valid builderAttestation, payloadDigest mismatch versus P, non-32-byte builderPublicKey, or a well-encoded 64-byte signature that is cryptographically invalid under the correct key.

The added vectors do not subsume those cases. Wrong key is not wrong member or payload; root/key/signature cross-event composition is not zero-or-duplicate root cardinality; malformed 128-hex encoding is not a bit-flipped but correctly encoded 64-byte signature; absent key is not a present wrong-length key; overlay refusal is not the loaded-section positive case.

The underlying v43 rules still make all dropped cases security-relevant: builderRoot requires exactly one match; kernelReleaseParse requires exactly one banner; builderPublicKey requires exactly 32 decoded bytes; payloadDigest and memberSha256 are signed joins; kexecCapability is a fixed signed token; and Ed25519 verify must fail closed.

g22.testMatrix names NT-TCB-1..4, not NT-TCB-KEXEC. No other current required-vector roster picks up the dropped Linux builder-attestation cases. basedOn points to v42 but the changed g22 leaf does not say cumulative, in-addition-to-v42, or prefix-preserving.
shouldFix.impact: A future G22 implementation can satisfy every v43-named required vector while failing to test root uniqueness, message-field binding, valid-length signature rejection, key-length rejection, release uniqueness, or the positive loaded-section/absent-branch composition. The successor repairs PTCB-V42-S2's newly requested branches by regressing earlier mandatory coverage.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Make the v43 vector roster the explicit union of every v42 required vector and every v43 addition. Preserve distinct vectors for wrong memberSha256, altered kexecCapability, payloadDigest mismatch, zero and duplicate builderRoot, zero and multiple linux_banner, present non-32-byte key, correctly encoded invalid signature under the correct key, valid loaded-section payload, and zero-marker absent branch with a valid builderAttestation. State that successor vector rosters are cumulative unless a named semantic withdrawal makes a vector obsolete.
